If these steps do not resolve the situation, please gather any error messages or logs that might help diagnose the problem and contact us back. Access this via Settings > System > Power & sleep > Additional power settings.  2. **Battery Saver**: Enable Battery Saver Mode to limit background activity when not plugged in. This tool offers options to enhance battery longevity depending on your use case, like Adaptive, Standard, and ExpressCharge modes.  8. **Microsoft Recommendations**: Follow Microsoft's best practices for battery life available on their support site.  9. **Diagnostics**: Run a full diagnostic test using the built-in Dell SupportAssist. This tool can identify battery performance issues and suggest actionable solutions.  All the tools mentioned here, like Dell Power Manager and SupportAssist, can be accessed via the Dell website if they are not pre-installed.   If further assistance is needed, feel free to reach out.
